instanceExperimentalSettings.Cases_description: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Classic_Task_Interface_description: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. instanceExperimentalSettings.Classic_Task_Interface_footnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Conference_Room_Chat_description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Decisions_description: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Detect_external_URLs_in_issues_and_show_: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Enable_the_experimental_shared_status_ca: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Enabling_Status_Cards_also_enables_Summa: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Experimental_features_may_break_at_any_t: Experimental features may break at any time.

instanceExperimentalSettings.Lookback_hours_must_be_a_whole_number_fr: Lookback hours must be a whole number from 1 to 720.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Managed_Sandbox_Only_description: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed sandbox environment.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Restore_the_Goals_item_in_the_main_sideb: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Run_Tasks_In_This_Worktree_description: This is an isolated git-worktree preview instance. Turn this on to let the scheduler execute runs here. Only tasks created after enabling will run automatically — copied/pre-existing tasks stay parked. Toggling off and on resets the cutoff.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Server_Info_Debug_View_description: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Show_Paperclip_managed_built_in_agent_su: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Show_Summarizer_generated_status_slots_o: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Show_accepted_plan_decomposition_history: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Show_environment_management_in_company_s: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Show_execution_workspace_controls_in_pro: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

instanceExperimentalSettings.Show_task_detail_controls_for_configurin: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Show_the_Apps_navigation_and_allow_acces: Show the Apps navigation and allow access to app connections, gateways, and advanced app tooling.
instanceExperimentalSettings.Simplified_English_Interactions_descript: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.

uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.after.description: One container, system-authored label, hidden details. The chat surface keeps user and agent bubbles unchanged.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.after.p2: Same content. The visible body is one short system sentence; reviewers expand Details only when they need run evidence. Tone is reinforced by the octagon icon and the "System alert" label, not just red.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.after.title: System notice replacement
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.before.description: The same content rendered through the existing user-bubble + warning-callout path. Two containers, same gray background as user comments, and the warning icon is forced inside a chat row.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.before.p2: Author reads as You even though the author is the Paperclip system. Two containers stack the warning inside a user-style bubble, and operational evidence is always visible.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.before.title: Today's nested treatment
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.description: Replaces the current pattern where a Paperclip-authored warning renders inside a user-style chat bubble. The notice is one container, system-styled, with hidden-by-default operational metadata. Tone is conveyed by icon, label, and color together so it stays accessible.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.handoffDesc: What the Phase 4 UI implementation should preserve from this design.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection1.descriptio: Each tone pairs a unique icon and tone label so the notice is recognizable without color. Collapsed is the default; the Details affordance reveals operational metadata only when reviewers ask for it.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection1.title: Three tones, two states
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection2.descriptio: Side-by-side with adjacent comment types so reviewers can confirm the system row reads as a system row — full width, no avatar gutter, no chat bubble — while user and agent comments keep their existing rounded bubbles.
uxLab.systemNoticeUxLab.labSection2.title: Distinct from user and agent comments
